$comment: Frozen WorkBuddy host runtime contract for the PD workbuddy-adapter, from Phase 0 real-host probes P01-P06 (2026-10-12). Host: WorkBuddy Desktop 5.8.1, engine codebuddy-lite-wb.mjs --version 2.161.0, SHA-256 fd9d20c75264d20caf8878edc9cf374b333081113595486628d0bd8b8ca374ad. Probes ran the REAL engine in an isolated config dir (WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR + CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR) with a local OpenAI-compatible mock model; hook pipeline, tool execution, payload construction and context assembly are genuine engine behavior. Only model decisions were synthetic.

provenance.platform: win32 x64, Git Bash enforced for command hooks
provenance.hookTimeoutObserved: per-hook timeout honored (probe used hooks.json timeout:30; hook killed at 30s)
provenance.evidenceBoundary: mock model; desktop UI review panel and interactive TUI not verifiable headlessly; resume/compact injection persistence not verified (feeder used --no-session-persistence)

SessionStart.fires: at session creation, before first prompt processing; source=startup observed

exitCodeEffects.exit0-with-stdout: stdout (raw text, even invalid JSON) is wrapped as <system-reminder data-role="hook"> and appended to the next user message visible to the model
exitCodeEffects.exit0-additionalContext: hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext value wrapped the same way (clean channel)
exitCodeEffects.exit2: NON-blocking for the session; stdout message still injected; stderr-only message NOT injected but session continues
exitCodeEffects.exit1-exit3: non-blocking; exit3 stdout WAS injected (any stdout injects); exit1 stderr not injected
exitCodeEffects.timeout: hook killed at configured timeout; session proceeds

UserPromptSubmit.fires: on real user prompt submission. CRITICAL: the FIRST startup prompt in -p print mode does NOT fire it (pre-marked reviewed); subsequent prompts in the same stream-json session DO. Desktop interactive sessions are expected to fire on every user prompt (unverified headlessly - PTY unavailable).

exitCodeEffects.exit0-stdout-any-exitcode: stdout appended to context as hook system-reminder before <user_query> (verified for exit 0 and exit 3)
exitCodeEffects.exit0-additionalContext: additionalContext value injected into the SAME turn's user message (recommended injection channel)
exitCodeEffects.exit2-stdout-msg: BLOCKS the prompt: prompt does not reach the model (model request count drops), stdout message shown as block reason
exitCodeEffects.exit2-stderr-only: BLOCKS the prompt (stderr is fallback message source; blocking still happens)
exitCodeEffects.stdout-closed-exit2: BLOCKS the prompt (exit code honored even when stdout closed)

PreToolUse.fires: after tool args built, before execution; matcher '*' matches all tools

exitCodeEffects.deny-json: tool BLOCKED (verified: target file not written); deny reason fed to the model as role=tool message 'Error: <reason>'
exitCodeEffects.exit2-stdout-msg: tool BLOCKED; message fed to model
exitCodeEffects.continue-false: tool BLOCKED; side effect: the user prompt gets re-submitted (UserPromptSubmit hook fired again in the same session) - do NOT use continue:false in the PD adapter
exitCodeEffects.stdout-closed-exit2: tool BLOCKED (exit code alone is sufficient)
exitCodeEffects.timeout: hook killed at configured timeout; tool BLOCKED (fail-closed on timeout)

PostToolUse.fires: after tool completes, INCLUDING is_error responses (file-not-found Read, directory Read, non-zero Bash). NOT for thrown tool errors (those go to PostToolUseFailure).

toolResponseShapes.Bash: OBJECT {exitCode:number, signal, interrupted, sandboxDenied, stderrBytesTruncated, stdoutBytesTruncated, tool_error_code}

exitCodeEffects.any-scenario: tool already ran; nothing is blocked. deny/exit2 have no undo effect. additionalContext is appended to the tool result message as <system-reminder data-role="tool-hint">

PostToolUseFailure.fires: ONLY when tool execution THROWS (verified: Write to an existing-unread file throws WriteFileNotReadError). Ordinary failures (is_error) do NOT reach this event.

payloadFields.verifiedExample: error='File has not been read yet...', tool_error_code='2009', tool_error_name='WriteFileNotReadError', is_interrupt=false

PostToolUseFailure.od02Conclusion: FAILED tool calls (the common pain-evidence class: file-not-found, runtime-wrong usage, non-zero bash) DO enter PostToolUse with is_error/exitCode markers, so after_tool_call evidence collection covers failures WITHOUT a new event. PostToolUseFailure adds only the thrown-error class (unknown-tool and schema-invalid calls are rejected before any hook fires).
PostToolUseFailure.amendment20261013: Independent re-verification (engine 2.161.0, sha256 1b1a01bc…, scripts/dev/workbuddy-probe/probe-post-tool-use-failure.mjs, lab D:\Code\wb-ptuf-lab\ptuf-1791905652552) FALSIFIED the first sentence's implied completeness for the thrown class: a Write to an existing-but-never-read file emits ONLY PostToolUseFailure (error='File has not been read yet…', tool_error_code='2009', NO tool_response) and PostToolUse never fires for it. hooks.json now registers PostToolUseFailure (matcher '*', wrapper event arg PostToolUseFailure) mapped onto the SAME after_tool_call HostEvent kind — still no new core event kind. The od02Conclusion above is preserved verbatim as the historical P03 reading it superseded.

ids.generation_id: present on all observed events incl. SessionStart; stable within one turn - maps to turnId
ids.call_id: present on tool events, equals tool_use_id, originates from the model tool_call id; two model-issued identical ids executed twice (no host-side dedup observed)
ids.transcript_path: present on all events; under WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR isolation resolves inside the isolated dir only when CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR is also set (else ~/.codebuddy)

injectionChannels.userPromptSubmit.additionalContext: VERIFIED: value lands in the same turn's user message as <system-reminder data-role="hook"> before <user_query>; fresh per turn
injectionChannels.userPromptSubmit.rawStdout: VERIFIED but UNSUITABLE: any stdout (even JSON garbage, even with exit 3) is injected verbatim; PD must emit structured JSON and keep stdout free of stray text
injectionChannels.sessionStart.rawStdout: verified injects (even with exit 2) - same unsuitability
injectionChannels.postToolUse.additionalContext: VERIFIED: appended to tool result as <system-reminder data-role="tool-hint">
injectionChannels.preToolUse.denyReason: VERIFIED: deny reason reaches the model as 'Error: <reason>' role=tool message
injectionChannels.modifiedInput: source names the field updatedInput in this engine build; NOT probed (first adapter version rejects it anyway)
injectionChannels.resumeCompactPersistence: UNKNOWN: not verified (probe feeder disabled session persistence)

shellAndRuntime.commandHooks: executed via Git Bash on Windows (SHELL=Git usr bin bash.EXE observed); 'node' resolves from PATH (system node v26 in probe), host does not force its bundled node
shellAndRuntime.cjsWrapper: VERIFIED: real .cjs wrapper launched via hook command with paths containing spaces AND Chinese characters in both plugin root and project cwd
shellAndRuntime.nativeDeps: better-sqlite3 with N-API prebuilds loads under node v26 (ABI 147) and host-bundled node v22 (ABI 127); the engine's own bundled better-sqlite3 is NOT requirable from outside (missing 'bindings' dependency resolution) - PD must ship its own runtime deps
shellAndRuntime.nodeVersions: node v26.7.0 baseline recorded; node v22.22.2 verified; node 20 NOT PRESENT on machine (NOT RUN)
